name: Negligee: Love Stories
source:
A series of four stories following the characters Karen, Charlotte, Sophie and Jasmin. Following their early lives and the decisions they had to make, whether to follow their heart or their head and how that impacts their lives.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/467680/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
以凯伦、夏洛特、苏菲和贾斯敏为主角的四个故事系列。追踪他们的早年生活和他们必须做出的决定，是跟随他们的内心还是他们的头脑，以及这如何影响他们的生活。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/467680/]Steam[/url]]
